subject: art-design
title: Formal Elements: The Seven
welcome_lead: Line, shape, form, tone, colour, pattern, texture — the building blocks.
meta_desc: KS3 formal elements introduction to all seven.
final_note: All artwork is built from these seven basics.

concepts.def: How a surface feels or looks.

walkthroughs.body_html: The seven formal elements are: line, shape, form, tone, colour, pattern, texture. Some lists add space as an eighth. Every artwork can be analysed by them.
A shape is flat — like a circle on paper. A form is 3D — like a sphere. Form has volume; you can hold it or imagine going around it.
Actual texture is real — rough sandpaper. Visual texture is the illusion of texture in a drawing — like crosshatching that looks like fur.

sequence.def: Drawing begins with lines on the page
When a line closes, it encloses a flat shape
Shading is applied across the shapes
Tone turns flat shapes into solid-looking forms
Surface marks are added over the modelled form
